findings.observation: Exactly one clearly adult 36-year-old woman appears with one coherent body, no secondary subject, and no duplicated anatomy.
The complete close-cropped hair and head, both hands, asymmetric hem, both trouser legs, both boots, recipe leaf, and grounding shadow remain fully visible inside generous parchment margins.

Visible brush planes, simplified illustrative skin and textile modeling, matte repaired cloth, controlled edges, and the warm parchment wash establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

Kelu’s plus-size heavy natural mass, medium-deep skin, broad oval face, small bright eyes, fine brows, broad low bridge, full lips, brow notch, red-copper close crop with sculpted edge pattern, teal-brown repaired asymmetric patchwork, uneven hem, toggles, practical trousers, knee folds, level chin, cuff-checking hand, and recipe leaf are legible. However, the declared compact finger-line tattoo family expands into large dense geometric markings across both hands and forearms, violating its bounded scope.
The level chin, steady small-eyed gaze, relaxed fine brows, and closed full lips read as calm and neutral without a smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

The repaired cloth, trousers, toggles, cord, paper leaf, and boots remain ordinary mortal materials with no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, or watermark. The recipe leaf nevertheless carries visible writing-like marks, conflicting with the strict no-text requirement.

Kelu’s heavy construction, close sculpted copper crop, marked broad face, teal-brown patchwork workwear, cuff-checking pose, tattoos, and recipe-leaf keepsake are visibly distinct from the reference person and do not transfer the reference braid, ochre robes, slim body, pose, progression ornament, or identity.
